correctness.rationale: The F2 even-subset quotient gives a six-dimensional symplectic module; a tetrad is a four-edge even-degree graph (210 four-cycles) or an eight-vertex perfect matching (105), independently yielding 315 isotropic planes. All 20,475 unordered four-edge sets and all 315 isotropic planes were independently enumerated, with explicit 315-to-315 equivariant bijection, then all 22 Frobenius cycle partitions and every permutation power were checked from the actual standalone files. Exactly 21 profiles occur; a unique collision and equality of natural component profiles are directly compared, and all first-five count tuples match the 21 profiles whereas four counts are noninjective. Irreducibility of explicit characteristic-three factors is exhaustively checked. The finite reduction proves all odd finite-field cases because every Frobenius permutation of eight points is an S8 conjugacy class.
